# Phone Repairs Den Bosch

> Phone Repairs is a repair shop in Den Bosch (Netherlands) for smartphones, tablets, MacBooks and Nintendo consoles. Repairs are done by appointment, mostly within about 30 minutes, while the customer waits and watches. Prices include fitting and 21% VAT. Most repairs come with 12 months warranty.

- Address: Ploossche Hof 13, 5233 HA Den Bosch (free parking in front of the shop)
- Phone / WhatsApp: 073 822 0013 (WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us)
- Email: info@phonerepairs.nl
- Opening hours: by appointment only. Mon–Thu 10:00–20:00, Fri–Sat 10:00–17:00, Sun 11:00–17:00
- Reviews: Kiyoh 9.9, Google 4.9
- Language: the site is in Dutch; an English version is at https://www.phonerepairs.nl/en

## How it works

- [How a repair works](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/werkwijze): pick your device and repair, book via WhatsApp or phone, watch the repair (usually about 30 minutes)
- [Make an appointment](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/afspraak)
- [Send in your device by mail](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/veelgestelde-vragen/reparatie-opsturen)
- [Warranty](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/garantie): 12 months on most repairs and batteries, 60 days on motherboard/microsoldering, 14 days on screen protectors, none on water damage. Covers only the replaced or repaired part; excludes drop, impact and moisture damage and normal wear
- [Insurance repairs](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/verzekering)
- [Service area](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/werkgebied)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/veelgestelde-vragen)
- [Customer service](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/klantenservice-phone-repairs)
- [Contact](https://www.phonerepairs.nl/contact)
